title: Allowance Spend Rate After Payday
dataSources: Nanit sleep sessions (`nanit:sleep`), Hatch routines (`hatch:routine`), school calendar events (`schoolcalendar:event`), allowance transactions (`allowance:txn`), and kid screen usage (`screentime:usage`).
app: Family-routine telemetry from Nanit sleep exports, Hatch routine data, school calendars, allowance and chore apps, and Apple Screen Time sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=allowance:txn
| search event_type="spend"
| bin _time span=1w
| stats sum(amount) as spend count as txns by _time child_name
| sort - _time
description: Tracks allowance spending after payday over time and breaks it out by child.
value: Post-payday spend velocity helps you coach pacing instead of only discovering an empty balance later.
implementation: Send allowance spending after payday events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1w granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of allowance spending after payday by child.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors how allowance spending after payday changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
